quotes: The Company continues to target spending of $185 million to $195 million during 2026, which includes: (1) organic growth capital expenditures of approximately $100 million (unchanged from prior guidance); (2) maintenance capital expenditures of approximately $55 million (prior guidance of $70 million to $80 million); and (3) PP&E and infrastructure investments of $30 million to $40 million to support the Company's ES business line and activity in adjacent markets, including electric power generation (prior guidance of approximately $15 million).

As previously announced, Enerflex has authorized approximately $100 million of investments in its ES facilities and capabilities, $15 million of which is included in Enerflex’s capital expenditure guidance for 2026.

risks.claim: Enerflex faces concentration and conversion risk on its behind-the-meter power generation backlog of more than 1.75 gigawatts through 2028, as over one gigawatt is tied to a single large-scale North American data center development.
quotes: The Company has been contracted to design, engineer, fabricate, and assemble over one gigawatt of low emission behind-the-meter natural gas-fired power generation units for a large-scale North American data center development.

Combined with additional project awards, including approximately 450 megawatts announced on October 1, 2026, Enerflex’s backlog of behind-the-meter natural gas-fired power generation now exceeds 1.75 gigawatts, with deliveries extending through 2028.
